title: 3.	SUSPECTED OVARIAN MASSES IN PRE – MENOPAUSAL WOMEN:

blocks.content:
SUSPECTED OVARIAN MASSES IN PRE – MENOPAUSAL WOMEN:

10% women undergo surgery due to ovarian mass.

Risk of cancer

Premenopausal – 1/1000.

Postmenopausal – 3/1000.

Types of Adrenal Masses

Benign Ovarian:

Functional

Follicular 3 – 5cm

Luteal

Theca lutein

Endometrioma

Serous cystadenoma

Mature Teratoma.

Benign Non – Ovarian.

Para tubal cyst

Hydrosalpinx

TO mass/abscess

Peritoneal pseudocyst

Appendiceal abscess.

Diverticular abscess

Pelvic kidney.

Primary Malignant Ovarian:

Germ cell

Dysgerminoma

Endometrial sinus

Teratoma

Choriocarcinoma

Sex – Cord stromal Tumors

Estrogen secreting tumors:

Granulosa – (Extreme of Age)

Sertoli cell

Thecoma – 1%.

Androgen secreting:

Sertoli ledying

Gonad blastoma

-Non functional

Fibroma

=> Meigs syndrome

Ascites.

Plural effusion

Torsion.

=> 30 year.

c. Epithelial

Serous

Most common

10% Bilateral

Mucinous

Endometrial

Clear cell

Brener

Secondary – Malignant:

Breast and GI

Benign cyst with solid components:

Fibroma

Thecoma

Dermoid/Teratoma

Transitional cell

Torsion ovary

Cystadenoma

Cyst adenofibroma

Assessment of ovarian masses:

Risk factor for malignancy

Protective factor for Malignancy

Family history of CA ovary, breast. History

Symptoms suggestive of

endometriosis

Symptoms suggestive of

Malignancy

 

Persistent abdominal distention

Loss of appetite/satiety

Abdominal/pelvic pain

Urinary frequency/urgency.

Examination:

Abdominal and vaginal examination

Local lymphadenopathy

Sensitivity 15 – 51% to detect ovarian mass.

Investigation:

CA – 125 (No need in simple cyst).

CA – 125 (sensitivity 81%, specificity 75%)

CA 125 is high in:

Endometriosis stage III & IV => upto several hundreds.

Fibroids.

Pregnancy

adenomyosis

Pelvic infections.

Epithelial CA – 80%.

CA 125 is low in

Caffeine intake

TAH

Smoking.

 

CA – 125:

<200 – Further investigations to exclude common differentials.

>200 – discussion with gynae oncologists.

Serial monitoring in case of raised – 125.

Tumor Makers:

LDH

B- HCG In complex masses

A - FP

 

 

USG:

Single most effective way.

TVS preferable.

TVS + TAS => large masses.

TVS + Doppler + 3D imagining

Improve sensitivity in complex cases.

decrease no of unnecessary staging laparotomies.

Doppler – No improvement in diagnostic accuracy.

USG rules derive from IOTA group:

B – Rules.

M – Rules.

Not clearly classified.

B – Rules:

Unilocular cyst.

Presence of solid components <7mm.

Presence of Acoustic shadowing.

Multilocular cyst.

Smooth.

<10cm up to 9cm.

No blood flow.

Sensitivity = 95%

Specificity = 91%

 

M – Rules:

Irregular solid tumor

Ascites

Papillary structures at least 4

Multilocular cyst

Irregular

> 10 cm.

Strong blood flow.

 

Any of M – Rule

Referral to Oncological Services.

 

Not clearly classification:

 

 

USG /Investigation by specialist in Gynecological USG.

Oncology referral:

Any M rule (without CT or MRI).

RMI of Malignancy Range.

CA – 125 > 200 – for further evaluation.

MRI, CT:

Don’t improve sensitivity or specificity over TVS alone.

Possibility of malignancy => Referral.

RMI calculation:

Models RMI I & II.

All women with suspected ovarian Malignancy

To triage the management.

RMI:

U x M x CA – 125.

Locularity

Laterality

Solid components

Ascites

Mets

M: 13

Post M = 3.

Ovarian Cyst

 

Surgical intervention

Indications

> 7cm.

Symptomatic of any size

Persistent cyst

Increasing size cyst

laparotomy
